title: Application log entry
description: One job application, tracked through its lifecycle. Records WHICH FRAMING was used (not just which job), so that when a result lands it can be attributed back to the evidence level. This is the substrate of the Win/Loss loop (see track/LOOP.md). Append-only history; human writes the hypothesis when a result lands.

role_archetype.description: The archetype used to bucket comparable outcomes, e.g. 'ai-native', 'agentic-ai', 'cloud-security'. Free string, but reuse values so patterns can be seen across ≥2 comparable applications.

resume_used.description: Which resume variant / framing set, e.g. 'ai-native-v3', 'cloud-security-v1'.

achievements_surfaced.description: Bank-entry ids that were promoted/added for this application. The link that makes attribution possible.

framing_notes.description: How the evidence was framed for this role (the deliberate choices).

eval_scores_at_send.description: Snapshot of the eval harness scores for the tailored output at send time (LLM-judge dims + overall). Lets you later ask: did a high judge score correlate with a real callback?

channel.description: A major confounder — always record it, so framing is never credited/blamed for what the channel did.

silence_after_weeks.description: Weeks of no response before 'silence' is recorded (define it once so 'silence' is consistent).

hypothesis.description: The human's one-line read when a result lands. NOT a conclusion — a hypothesis to confirm only if it repeats across ≥2 comparable outcomes.
